description: The Separation schema of first-order set theory has one axiom for each formula \(\varphi(x,p_1,\ldots,p_k)\) in which \(B\) is not free: for every set \(A\) and all set parameters \(p_1,\ldots,p_k\), there is a set \(B\) such that \(x\in B\) holds exactly when \(x\in A\) and \(\varphi(x,p_1,\ldots,p_k)\), for every set \(x\).
